rationale: The account's remaining daily loss budget is only $38.37, while a single share of GEV at $887.75 with a wide $1.19 bid-ask spread and a 5-minute ATR of $4.44 makes it impossible to structure any valid risk level without risking an immediate breach of the daily loss limit. Even at the minimum permitted position size of 0.5% of buying power, a normal intraday fluctuation of one ATR would result in a loss exceeding the remaining budget. Therefore, skipping is required to preserve capital and adhere to risk constraints.
